funFacts: Caffeine kicks in after about 20 minutes and peaks at 45 minutes.
Finland has the highest coffee consumption in the world: ~12 kg per person per year! 🇫🇮
Espresso has MORE caffeine per ml, but LESS per cup than filter coffee.
Beethoven counted exactly 60 beans per cup. Every. Single. Morning. ☕
Coffee was called 'Satan's drink' in 17th century Europe – until the Pope tried it and blessed it.
Goats discovered coffee! An Ethiopian herder noticed his goats dancing after eating red berries. 🐐
Caffeine is technically an insecticide – plants produce it to ward off bugs. 🐛
You could theoretically die from caffeine – but you'd need ~100 cups in a short time.
Caffeine affects your DNA repair. Moderate amounts may actually be protective. 🧬
The world's most expensive coffee (Kopi Luwak) comes from cat poop. Yes, really. 💩☕
NASA scientists found that spiders on caffeine spin the most chaotic webs. 🕷️
Germans drink ~164 liters of coffee per person per year – more than beer! 🇩🇪
Caffeine boosts athletic performance by 3-5%. Many athletes use it as legal doping. 🏃
Dark roast has LESS caffeine than light roast. The roasting process breaks caffeine down.
Decaf coffee still contains 2-15 mg of caffeine per cup. Truly caffeine-free? Nope.
Sweden has 'Fika' – the official coffee break is basically a legal right. 🇸🇪
Your body resets caffeine tolerance in 3-5 days – then that first cup hits like a rocket again. 🚀
Instant coffee was invented in 1901 by a Japanese chemist in Chicago. Plot twist!
Caffeine's half-life is 5-6 hours – a coffee at 4 PM is still half-active at 10 PM.
Bach composed a 'Coffee Cantata' – an entire piece about coffee addiction. 🎵
In Turkey, a woman could divorce her husband if he failed to provide her with coffee.
In Ethiopia, coffee is traditionally served with butter. 🧈
Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors – that's why you feel EXTRA tired when it wears off. That's the 'crash'.
Studies show the smell of coffee alone can reduce stress – no sipping required. 👃
